أتضارب (form VI)
# أَتَضَارَبُ (ʔataḍārabu) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ra.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
# أَتَضَارَبَ (ʔataḍāraba) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.ra.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
# أَتَضَارَبْ (ʔataḍārab) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.rab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَضَارَبَ (taḍāraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
